goal: Build a deterministic, capability-profile-driven bootstrap compiler with pure rendering, typed transition decisions, recoverable transactions, separate mechanical/readiness reporting, and shared Copier/GitHub validation.

phases.name: Tooling, value algebra, and determinism foundations

tasks.name: Establish uv source tooling and explicit Python 3.14 validation
inputs: design dependency policy; modern-python guidance; current standalone Python scripts.
tasks.description: Create the root uv project metadata without packaging the template as a distributable library. Add grouped source dependencies with `uv add`: pytest, Hypothesis, Ruff, ty, and PyYAML in their appropriate development groups. Set `requires-python = ">=3.14"`, configure Ruff and ty for Python 3.14 and strict core checking, and create `.python-version` pinned to 3.14. Make `uv run` the documented execution path for source checks; CI installs the pinned uv release and Python 3.14 with Astral's `setup-uv` action. Nix and its flake remain optional maintainer tooling, while generated projects use portable Python/uv validation and do not inherit source-only uv metadata. PyYAML was removed from the toolchain by revision 16 (T16) and restored as a runtime dependency by revision 17; this task's record is historical.

tasks.name: Integrate Copier and GitHub generation paths
inputs: updated ADR 0001; Copier ownership exclusions; GitHub snapshot cleanup inventory; generated workflow and validation boundaries.
tasks.description: First update ADR 0001 to state that Copier owns source lifecycle updates while bootstrap owns derived-output reconciliation. Then wire Copier to retain source lifecycle inputs while excluding generated managed/seed/cleanup outputs, including the source `pyproject.toml`, `.python-version`, `uv.lock`, flake files, maintainer-only Nix actions, and maintainer-only workflows. Split the generated portable workflow baseline from source-maintainer CI and release gating so generated projects do not require Nix; only the selected `nix` capability may render Nix artifacts or CI contributions. Replace any remaining Bash workflow adapters with Python entry points or native action steps and remove ShellCheck policy and configuration; no `.sh` entry point is retained. Add GitHub snapshot cleanup and ownership declarations; the GitHub cleanup inventory must include source uv and Nix maintenance inputs, while Copier excludes them from generated projects. Ensure both paths initialize a Git working tree before bootstrap, recognize only their legal scaffold shapes, and share the same compiler and transaction shell.
